title: Changed-Mind Return Review Thresholds for Northgate Purchases & Returns Memberships
content:
Northgate Purchases & Returns reviews returns across all purchases of a membership, not purchase by purchase.

## Standard

A changed-mind return is refunded by member services only while both of the following hold for the membership, each measured over the rolling 365 calendar days ending today and across every purchase carrying that membership number:

- the number of refunds booked with return reason changed mind is below **18**; and
- the total amount of those changed-mind refunds is below **2500.00** USD.

Once either measure reaches its threshold, further changed-mind returns on that membership are decided by the club's membership office, not by member services. The evidence is the system record of refund entries on the membership's purchases, matched by membership number.

Returns for defective, not as described, damaged in transit, missing parts or not received merchandise, and cancellation refunds, are never held by this review.

When a refunded sale line is covered by an active Northgate Care protection plan, the plan is refunded under the protection plan's own terms; the merchandise refund here is not reduced for it.

## Thresholds on both sides

| Changed-mind refunds in the last 365 days | Their total (USD) | Who decides a further changed-mind return |
|---|---|---|
| 17 | 2499.99 | member services (both below) |
| 18 | 900.00 | the club's membership office (count reached) |
| 5 | 2500.00 | the club's membership office (value reached) |
| 25 | 3100.00 | the club's membership office |

The figures in the table are hypothetical membership histories; the thresholds 18 and 2500.00 are the standard.

## Points of judgement

- Counting is by membership, so changed-mind refunds on every purchase of that membership in the window count together.
- A defective return on a membership already at 18 changed-mind refunds is not held by this review.
